summary: Fetches, caches, and parses the server-emitted capabilities manifest (GET /v1/capabilities), then turns it into a typed command tree, URL builder, and precedence-resolved context that the bp CLI drives off — with zero hardcoded nouns, verbs, or routes.

intentions.title: Self-describing API: CLI driven entirely by server-emitted manifest
intentions.evidence: manifest.go package doc states 'hardcodes NO noun, verb, flag, or route'; tree.go builds noun->verb tree purely from Manifest.Nouns+Commands; plugins add commands with zero code change

intentions.title: Zero-downtime extensibility via plugin-contributed commands
intentions.evidence: Noun.Plugin field in manifest.go; tree.go synthesizes nodes for any command whose noun appears in the manifest, including plugin-owned ones

intentions.title: Offline-friendly CLI via ETag-based manifest caching
intentions.evidence: fetch.go implements If-None-Match / 304 flow; cache.go provides on-disk ETag store keyed by server URL + token salt; 304 path skips re-parse entirely

intentions.title: Deterministic context resolution with clear precedence (flags > env > active > defaults)
intentions.evidence: context.go Resolve() picks first non-empty value per field across four layers; FlagServer/Token/etc constants keep flag-parsing layer in sync

intentions.title: Forward-compatible scoped-prefix routing seam
intentions.evidence: url.go BuildURL respects ctx.ScopedMirror guard; ScopedMirror=false keeps prefix inert today; manifest already ships scoped_prefix hint so no breaking change when server adds mirror

intentions.title: Fail-fast manifest contract enforcement
intentions.evidence: manifest.go Parse uses DisallowUnknownFields + explicit manifest_version check; url.go errors loudly on unresolved path placeholders rather than sending malformed URLs
